summary: Eight-band parametric EQ, minimum phase and zero latency (Phase Linear: the same response as one linear-phase filter, 4607 samples late, with a 32-point Curve layer): bell, low and high shelf, low and high cut at 12/24/48 dB/oct, notch; frequency in Hz, gain in 0.1 dB steps, Q. Bands 2–7 start on at 0 dB (transparent until a gain is set); the cuts, bands 1 and 8, start off. Use it for precise, labelled moves such as "B3: Bell, 320 Hz, −3 dB, Q 1.4". Mode Graphic makes it a 31-band graphic EQ at the ISO third-octave centres (G 20 Hz … G 20 kHz, ±18 dB in 0.1 dB steps) whose response passes through its sliders: for a curve given band by band, such as "G 125 Hz −3 dB, G 4 kHz +2 dB". v2: each band on Stereo, Left, Right, Mid or Side; shapes (proportional-Q bell, Baxandall and Vintage shelves, all-pass); dynamic bands (gain down or up above a threshold, the detector on the band's own shape or on the sidechain, input 2), e.g. "B5: Bell, 6.5 kHz, Side, dynamic Down, threshold −30 dB, range 6 dB" to tame sibilance; Delta, and the gain-match reading.

parameters.name: B1 channel
parameters.description: Band 1: which channel it works on. Stereo: both (as v1); Left or Right: that one alone; Mid or Side: the mid (L+R)/2 or the side (L−R)/2 alone, the other untouched (mid/side encoded and decoded around the band)

parameters.name: B1 shape
parameters.description: Band 1: Standard: the type as it is (as v1). Proportional Q: a bell narrows as its gain grows (Q × 10^(|gain|/40): about twice as narrow for every 12 dB). Baxandall: a shelf becomes first order, 6 dB/oct, the gentle tone-control curve (Q unused). Vintage: a shelf gets its complementary dip, Pultec-style: a bell of half its gain the other way, Q 1, an octave above a low shelf or below a high shelf. All-pass: whatever the type, the band only turns the phase (second order at its frequency, Q its width)

parameters.name: B1 dynamic
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic EQ (bells and shelves): Down: above the threshold the band's gain moves down (compresses what it hears), Up: it moves up; by the ratio, at most Range. The detector hears the band's own shape (a band-pass for a bell, low-pass for a low shelf, high-pass for a high shelf). Off: static (as v1)

parameters.name: B1 threshold
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic: the level the band's detector must pass before its gain moves (dBFS, the envelope of what it hears)

parameters.name: B1 ratio
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic: the gain moves by 1 − 1/ratio dB for each dB over the threshold (∞: all of it)

parameters.name: B1 knee
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic: width of the soft knee around the threshold

parameters.name: B1 range
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic: the most the gain moves from its setting

parameters.name: B1 attack
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic: time to 63 % of a gain change

parameters.name: B1 release
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic: time back to 37 % of a gain change

parameters.name: B1 detector
parameters.description: Band 1 dynamic: Band: the detector hears the band's own input; Sidechain: the machine's second input (connect a machine to it), through the same shape and channel

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the EQ changes: the output minus the input, before Output (zero latency, nothing to delay), gliding over 10 ms. Off for rendering

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description: Minimum: the bands as always, zero latency.
